title: Dreams of a Drowned Crown
text: On the same night, in every Seat, someone dreams of the same palace: green water in the throne room, courtiers with their eyes eaten, and on the throne a King with his crown nailed on, beckoning. In the morning the dreamers' pillows are wet.

options.label: Let them dream it again, and write down every door of the drowned palace.

outcomes.text: Night after night they walk the drowned palace and map it, until they know its every door. They come to know its King, too, and he them.

options.label: Have the chapel keep a vigil over the dreamer so the King cannot find them.

outcomes.text: The priests sit by the bed and sing. The dreamer sleeps without dreams, and on the throne the King turns his face to look for someone else.

options.label: Wake them every hour until it stops; no King will have them.

outcomes.text: It stops. The dreamer is short-tempered for a month and will not go near water.
